title: Computer Fraud and Abuse Act, 18 U.S.C. 1030
summary: Prohibits intentionally accessing a computer without authorization or exceeding authorized access, and knowingly transmitting code that damages a protected computer.

title: Wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. 1343
summary: Prohibits using interstate wire communications as part of a scheme to defraud or obtain money or property by false pretenses.

title: Stalking, 18 U.S.C. 2261A
summary: Prohibits a course of conduct, including via electronic means, intended to harass or intimidate or that causes substantial emotional distress or fear of harm.

title: Interstate threats, 18 U.S.C. 875(c)
summary: Prohibits transmitting interstate communications containing a threat to injure another person.

title: Chemical weapons, 18 U.S.C. 229
summary: Prohibits developing, producing, acquiring or using chemical weapons.

title: Biological weapons, 18 U.S.C. 175
summary: Prohibits developing, producing, stockpiling or acquiring biological agents or toxins for use as a weapon.

title: Child sexual abuse material, 18 U.S.C. 2252 / 2252A
summary: Prohibits producing, distributing, receiving or possessing sexually explicit material involving minors.
